title: Fix a Slow Bathroom Sink Without Chemicals #shorts
keys: hair stopper clip snake trash chemical toxic grease seal follow slow twist lift

segments.text: Slow bathroom sink? It's usually hair. Here's the fix, no harsh chemicals.
One. Twist the stopper and lift it out. If it's stuck, there's a clip on the rod under the sink. Pull off the hair.
Two. Still slow? Push a cheap plastic drain snake in, twist, and pull up slowly. Put what comes out in the trash, not back down the drain.
Three. Skip the harsh chemical cleaners. They can damage pipes, and mixing them with bleach can release toxic gas.
And in the kitchen, never pour grease down the drain. Let it cool, seal it in a jar, and trash it.
